tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tshar chen rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung thor bu khag gi dkar chag/ 001 rje btsun rin po che bsod nams rtse mo'i rnam par thar pa don gyi snying po bsdus pa/ 002 dpal ldan bla ma dam pa kun spangs chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar dad pa'i spu long g.yo ba/ 003 rang gi rtogs pa brjod pa lam glu dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ 004 rje btsun kun spangs chen po la bstod pa mtha' yas ma/ 005 rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po la wa bhu ti pa'i rnam thar bstod pa/ 006 rdo rje 'chang sgo rum pa chen po'i rnam thar gsol 'debs byang phyogs mkhas grub ma/ 007 rje btsun 'khrul zhig ka bzhi pa'i zhal snga nas la gsol 'debs/ 008 mkhas btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug rje btsun blo gsal rgya mtsho'i mgur 'bum gyi tshogs lam bzang gsal ba'i 'od snang / 009 gsang ba'i rnam thar bka' rgya ma/ 010 dpal rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ 011 pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i sgo nas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub bsgrub pa dang slob ma rjes su bzung ba'i cho ga nag po 'gro shes/ 012 rta mgrin grub rgyal lugs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi yi ge/ 013 rta mgrin shangs lugs kyi mngon rtogs/ 014 dpal rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi byin rlabs kyi cho ga bar chad kun sel/ 015 pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa dpa' bo gcig pa/ 016 bcom ldan 'das yang gsang khros pa yab yum rkyang sgrub kyi sgrub thabs rgyun khyer dngos grub myur stsol/ 017 dpal pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i bsnyen pa'i kha skong dngos grub bsdu ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga dngos grub rin po che'i bang mdzod/ 018 dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde mchog rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po dbang bskur ba'i tho yig 019 nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i brgyud pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa pad dkar bzhad pa'i dga' ston/

020 mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam/ 021 dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lam gyi smon lam lam bzang 'grub pa'i dga' ston/ 022 las kyi gshin rje 'khor bcas la mchod gtor 'bul ba'i cho ga 023 spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor gyi nyams len ye shes gsal ba'i sgron me/ 024 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho'i gsung mgur las zhal gdams 'ga' zhig zur du bkol ba/ 025 myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa la bstod cing bskul ba/ 026 gying lnga gza' gdong gi gtor chog rje bla mas mdzad pa/ 027 dbang sdud 'dod rgyal gyi man ngag gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bla ma dam par gsol 'debs pad+ma ra ga'i chun po/ 028 ku ru kul+le'i 'khor lo'i yig chung / 029 me pho 'brug lo dpal zhwa lu'i ma he mchod pa gnang dus kyi sgo yig bka' shog 030 chos skyong stag zhon gyi gtor chog 031 myur mdzad yid bzhin nor bu'i bstod pa rje bla mas mdzad pa/ 032 bstan srung chen mo dpal ldan rdo rje rab brtan ma'i rjes gnang / 033 dpal ldan lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i mngon rtogs/ 034 lha mo'i bstod pa bskul ba dang bcas pa/ 035 dpal zhwa lu ba'i chos skyong spyi bstod zhal snga nas tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa/ 036 dpal ldan lha mo ri phug ma dgyes pa'i bstod pa/ 037 chos skyong rgyal po chen po'i gtor 'bul rje tshar pas mdzad pa/ 038 ja mchod rgya ja'i chu gter rba rlabs g.yo ba'i dga' ston/ 039 mgon po stag zhon snubs lugs kyi gtor chog 'phrin las lhun grub/ 040 dpal ldan sa skya pa'i khyad par gyi gser chos dmar po skor gsum zhes grags pa'i chos skor gyi dkar chag dbang sdud pad+ma rā ga'i za ma tog gi kha 'byed gnad kyi lde mig 041 bla ma lnga bcu pa'i 'grel pa dngos grub rin po che'i sgo 'byed/ 042 rje btsun 'brog mi lo tsā ba la bstod pa snyan brgyud kyi pad mtsho bzhad pa/

043 'jam dbyangs 'khon ston la bstod pa/ 044 gtsang stod 'dar gyi chos grwa'i bskor bsrungs rnam gnyis mchod pa'i cho ga 045 dpal ldan bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga dngos grub rin po che'i gter mdzod/ 046 dpal ldan bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga dngos grub rin po che'i bang mdzod/ 047 rje btsun bla ma yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan la brten nas rgyas pa'i dngos grub bsgrub pa'i thabs tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa bcas bzhugs so// 048 rgyal mtshan bla mas mdzad pa'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang / 049 'od gsal 'char sgo ngos 'dzin/ 050 khyung po rnal 'byor pas mdzad pa'i bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi sgrub thabs/ 051 dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma la gsungs pa'i thar lam gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ bshes spring / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
